extraction.name: NeedleBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive synthetic framework designed to assess retrieval and reasoning performance in bilingual long-context tasks with adaptive context lengths (e.g., 32k, 128k, and beyond). It systematically embeds key data points at varying depths to rigorously test models' capabilities in diverse settings, including information-sparse and information-dense tasks.
extraction.creator: Mo Li, Songyang Zhang, Taolin Zhang, Haodong Duan, Yunxin Liu, Kai Chen
extraction.rai:dataCollection: NeedleBench is a synthetic framework. It embeds key data points (needles) at varying depths into background text (haystack). Needles are synthetic, abstract, and fictional statements or relational facts. The haystack for English tasks uses passages from the PaulGrahamEssays dataset, and for Chinese tasks, the ChineseDomainModelingEval dataset. The Ancestral Trace Challenge (ATC) generates synthetic family relationship datasets using a systematic algorithmic approach.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: PaulGrahamEssays dataset for English tasks; ChineseDomainModelingEval dataset for Chinese tasks.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Needles are strategically inserted at various depths into the haystack. In the Ancestral Trace Challenge, relationship statements are shuffled to eliminate positional bias.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Token lengths are measured using the GPT-4 tokenizer. A buffer is subtracted from the target context length when generating each input to mitigate the risk of instruction truncation due to tokenizer discrepancies.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset is synthetically generated using algorithms. Ground truth answers are computed automatically based on the constructed family structure or inserted facts. No human annotation was used to create the dataset labels.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. The dataset uses synthetic, abstract, and fictional statements or relational facts with randomized names to avoid overlap with real-world knowledge.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and may not fully reflect the complexity of real-world tasks. The filler text (haystack) is sourced from specific datasets (PaulGrahamEssays, ChineseDomainModelingEval), which may introduce linguistic or topical biases.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: NeedleBench is a synthetic benchmark and may not fully reflect the complexity of real-world tasks.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLM retrieval and reasoning performance in bilingual long-context tasks; assessing capabilities in information-sparse and information-dense settings.
